description: For a cash balance and the person's tax rates, estimate what each kind of cash option keeps per year after federal and state income tax (Treasury interest is state-tax-free; money funds pass through their government share), and how much more than where the cash sits now. Returns the best option of each kind.

current.description: Where the cash sits now: a broker name (its default sweep), "checking", or an id from get_cash_rates. Default checking at 0.01%.

federal_pct.description: Top federal income tax bracket, e.g. 24.

niit.description: True if the 3.8% net investment income tax applies.

priority.description: return (default), liquidity (2 days or less), or protection (FDIC or U.S. government).

state_pct.description: State + local income tax rate, e.g. 5. 0 if none.

name: compare_after_tax
title: Compare cash options after tax
